historicalFailures.problem: Android Three.js placed an object but the final display pixel assertion failed while the phone editor gizmo was enabled.
historicalFailures.failureExcerpt: AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: application object pixels reach phone screen
historicalFailures.correction: Cycle the real control through rotate to disabled using two real left clicks, then capture unobstructed pixels. Thresholds and application rendering are unchanged.
historicalFailures.measurementLimitation: Initial numeric pixel values were not retained before the failing assertion. Later instrumentation persists them before asserting; later passing measurements are not presented as values from this failure.

requirementCorrections.originalAssumption: Empty lists and any list containing point must reject NotSupportedError.
requirementCorrections.correction: Accept and retain lists; empty produces no hits and absent point data does not suppress plane/mesh hits.
requirementCorrections.primaryEvidence: Pinned Hit Test WD sections 3–7: effective entity lists and filtering native candidates; no unsupported-type exception establishes the old assumption.
requirementCorrections.rationale: Preserve legal subscriptions and meaningful filtering.

requirementCorrections.originalAssumption: All origin/direction coordinates can be used without conversion and must be finite.
requirementCorrections.correction: DOMPointInit origins use unrestricted double, while XRRayDirectionInit uses restricted double; convert both dictionaries before constructor validation.
requirementCorrections.primaryEvidence: Pinned Hit Test WD section 9 and WebIDL 622910c numeric/dictionary/overload algorithms.
requirementCorrections.rationale: Accept legal numeric coercion/nonfinite origins while rejecting nonfinite directions and invalid homogeneous coordinates.

requirementCorrections.originalAssumption: An initial documentation draft attributed shutdown removal to an explicit Hit Test WD cleanup step.
requirementCorrections.correction: Shutdown deactivation is the emulator cleanup policy; the draft separately rejects cancellation of inactive sources.
requirementCorrections.primaryEvidence: Pinned Hit Test section 4 active-source definitions/cancel algorithms and pinned WPT source_cancel comment leaving post-end behavior unspecified.
requirementCorrections.rationale: Preserve required release behavior without inventing normative provenance.

requirementCorrections.originalAssumption: A transient fixture assumed XRInputSourceArray provides Array includes.
requirementCorrections.correction: Consume its iterable interface with Array.from.
requirementCorrections.primaryEvidence: Pinned Device CRD XRInputSourceArray indexed/iterable IDL.
requirementCorrections.rationale: Fix observation while retaining real input events, groups and unchanged acceptance.

instrumentation: Actual extension builds, fresh browser profiles and genuine DevTools panel configuration.
Pinned applications/dependencies served unchanged; application requests and capability exposure preserved.
Original XR requests, results/Promises, exceptions and rendering callbacks retained. Sample module and Three.js existing observation hooks only.
Direct original room-mesh raycaster independently checks plane-region hit and placement positions in world coordinates.
Real panel TransformControls/viewer and phone poses; actual Quest panel select clicks and real Android pointer gestures. Two actual left phone clicks disable its editor gizmo before pixel capture.
Additional observer-owned transient requests on Android; off-target injected iframe for cross-realm accessors. Retain frozen groups, input identity, traces, cancellation observations and failures.
Actual application texture plus next natural presentation render pixels; Quest stereo and Android mono.
Browser force-cache dependency rereads hash actual cached responses to unchanged external dependency requests; local served source/asset bytes separately hashed.
Contract-only controlled unavailable matrix provider restored synchronously; no application GL, timers, callbacks or geometry replaced.
skips: Full native WPT suite and non-hit-test WPT cases are not claimed; six vendored subscription files are adapted/inspected rather than unchanged execution.
Physical hardware, feature-point generation and other unfinished API modules are outside this emulator task.
No generic test:browser verification rerun and no independent AI re-review; affected plane/geometry/anchor/transient regressions were selected from actual changes.
